skill_name: Come up with a unique recipe that incorporates spinach.
workflow: Veggie Lasagna with Spinach Filling: Preheat oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with a few teaspoons of oil. Add 1/2 an onion, diced, and 1/2 a bell pepper, diced, and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Add 3 cloves of minced garlic and stir. Add a 10-ounce package of frozen, thawed, and squeezed of excess moisture spinach and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
